findings.summary: D13: The plan says blockingFindings excludes accepted bot-resolved threads, but it returns them and delegates exclusion to gateFindings, so the exported interface differs although the gate behaves correctly.

D14: The plan says each recorded slot identifies the review it relies on, but the gate accepts any non-empty by value and even a different bot's slot entry, weakening record traceability while live coverage still controls passage.

D15: Task 23 does not propose changing control-file parsing, but the diff relocates the reviewers instruction and adds a label-gate regression test to exclude .review/ from parsed control files, a harmless additional fix.
